title: Check and correct a field — and it learns
description: Shows a new user how to clear a flagged field in Review and why it pays off. A brand-new sender (Ironbridge Fabrication) arrives with its details flagged for a check because ScanFinder hasn't filed from it before — the company name reads at lower confidence. The viewer sees the honest mechanic: read the value against the page, click the field, type it exactly as printed, and confirm; confirming files it AND teaches the sender, so future documents read more confidently and eventually file themselves. Reframed from the original (no demo document actually mis-reads its issuer — every read is correct but low-confidence — so the narration no longer claims a wrong value; it teaches checking + the same click-and-type fix action). The group is auto-expanded on load and the first doc auto-selects, so the sender group is pointed at (not clicked, which would collapse it) and a document row is opened directly.

steps.narration: When a document arrives from a sender ScanFinder hasn't filed before, it flags the details for you to check first. Clearing them takes seconds — and it's never wasted, because every check teaches it.
steps.caption: Check it once, and it learns

steps.narration: Everything waiting is grouped by sender. Here's a brand-new supplier, with three invoices flagged for a look — ScanFinder isn't sure of them yet because it's the first time it has seen this letterhead.
steps.caption: New sender · flagged for a check

steps.narration: Read each detail on the left against the page on the right. The company name is the one to watch on a new sender — it's a free-text read, so it comes in with lower confidence. This one has actually read correctly.
steps.caption: Check each detail against the page

steps.narration: Whether a detail's spot-on or a letter's out of place, you set it right the same way: click the field, and type it exactly as it's printed on the page.
steps.caption: 3. Type it exactly as printed

steps.narration: Now confirm. It's filed — and here's the part that matters: ScanFinder has learned this sender, so its next invoices read more confidently, and after a few clean confirms it files them without asking at all.
steps.caption: 4. Confirm — and it remembers

steps.narration: That's the rhythm of the first week or two: a quick check here and there, each one teaching it, until the filing quietly takes care of itself.
steps.caption: Early checks = less to do later
